description: Na₂SbSO₄F₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to four O and four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.78 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and three F atoms. Both Sb-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and one longer (1.99 Å) Sb-F bond length. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-64°. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sb, and one S atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Sb atom.
